label: pass
title: Add a low-stock section to inventory reports
body:
Buyers want to see what is about to run out. In src/report.js:

- `summary()` should include `lowStock`: titles with 1–3 units in stock (not zero — those are already in `outOfStock`), as `{ id, title, stock }`, sorted by stock ascending then title.
- The text report and the Markdown report should both show a "Low stock" section listing them with their stock count (omit the section when the list is empty).

Don't change the other sections.
plan:
Add low-stock section to inventory reports: compute lowStock in summary and render it in text and markdown outputs when non-empty.
1. Compute lowStock in summary and include in returned object
2. Render lowStock in plain-text report when present
3. Render lowStock in Markdown report when present
requirements: summary(books, options) returns an object including a new key lowStock which is an array of titles with stock 1..3 inclusive, each item { id, title, stock }
lowStock array must be sorted by stock ascending, then by title ascending
renderText(s) must include a "Low stock" section listing titles with their stock counts when s.lowStock is non-empty; omit the section if empty
renderMarkdown(s) must include a "## Low stock" section with a bulleted list of titles and their stock counts when s.lowStock is non-empty; omit the section if empty
No other existing sections or behavior should be changed
summary:
Added lowStock calculation and rendering to src/report.js. summary() now includes lowStock: titles with stock 1..3 as {id, title, stock}, sorted by stock then title. renderText and renderMarkdown now include low-stock sections when non-empty. Verified by running npm test --silent; all tests unchanged except a pre-existing failing math divide-by-zero test unrelated to this change.

Requirements:
1. R1: summary includes lowStock (src/report.js summary)
2. R2: excludes outOfStock (filter b.stock > 0) (src/report.js summary)
3. R3: sorted by stock then title (sort in summary)
4. R4: renderText includes 'Low stock' section when present (src/report.js renderText)
5. R5: renderMarkdown includes '## Low stock' section when present (src/report.js renderMarkdown)
6. R6: No other sections changed (only additions to report.js)
verify: npm test --silent: exit before=1 after=1; no new test failures
